# Playbooks: Resolve blockers and dependencies (`lpm-unblock-work`)

Run only the playbook that `lpm-unblock-work.md` names: find its `## § flow-<name>` section, do its steps in order, and reply with its Answer block only.

## § flow-diagnose

## Playbook: diagnose
Use when: what is blocked, or why X is blocked

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| x | the activity the user asks about: its id or its exact title | "none" (the whole project) |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The diagnosis is incomplete; nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   SAVE: connector = "yes" when result.credential == "oauth", else "no"
   IF <saved:connector> == "yes" → go to step 3.
2. CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → go to step 3.
   SAVE: blocked = one line per item: "<id> <title>: <each details label: value>"; more = "more than 100 blocked" when result.nextCursor is not empty, else "none"
   Read "Bloqueadores: Status bloqueado" as "no same-project link"; the cause is then the "Contexto do bloqueio" line.
   GO TO step 4
3. CALL `get_project_dependency_graph` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","blockedOnly":true,"maxTaskNodes":50} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "I cannot read the blocked activities of <input:projectId>: <error text>. The blocked list needs a project-owner, product-owner or delivery-lead role and an API key; the graph needs the project in a workspace."
   SAVE: blocked = one line per node with kind "task", projectId == <input:projectId> and status "blocked": "<taskId> <label>"; more = "graph truncated" when result.density.limited == true, else "none"
4. CALL `get_project_dependency_summary` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: upstream = "unavailable: <error text>"; go to step 5.
   SAVE: upstream = one line per distinct item of the blockers[] of every result.criticalBlockers item: "<issueId> <title> (<status>, project <projectId>) blocks <that chain's issueId>, impact <impactCount>", lines with isOnCriticalPath true first, then higher impactCount first
   Use this for cross-project blockers: the blocked list of step 2 shows same-project links and blocker contexts only.
5. IF <input:x> == "none" → go to Answer.
   SAVE: xid = the id in <saved:blocked> whose id or title == <input:x>, else <input:x>
6. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<input:x> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; xStatus = result.status; context = result.blockerContext.content when result.blockerContext.status == "active", else "none"
   IF <saved:connector> == "yes" → go to step 9.
7. CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: ups = {issueId: sourceIssueId, linkId: id} of each item with type "blocks" and targetIssueId == <saved:xid>, plus {issueId: targetIssueId, linkId: id} of each item with type "is-blocked-by" and sourceIssueId == <saved:xid>
   Ignore types "duplicates" and "related-to": they never block.
8. FOR EACH up IN <saved:ups> (none → go to step 9):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Link <each:linkId> is dangling: <each:issueId> no longer exists, yet it still blocks <saved:xid>. Remove it with playbook remove-link (it asks first)."
9. SAVE: causes = each step 8 upstream as "<issueId> <status> (link <linkId>)", plus the lines of <saved:upstream> that block <saved:xid>, plus "context: <saved:context>" when <saved:context> != "none"
   IF <saved:causes> is empty → SAVE: causes = "no open blocker found"; go to Answer.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId> | <input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle> (status <saved:xStatus>)
Done: read-only diagnosis, nothing changed
Evidence: blocked: <the lines of <saved:blocked> joined by "; " | none>; upstream: <saved:upstream>; <saved:xid>: <saved:causes>
Pending: <none | <saved:more>>
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | unblock first: the first line of <saved:upstream> | none — nothing is blocked>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled; "blocked" in the graph or the summary is derived, never an activity status. A link stops blocking when its upstream is done or canceled. Never claim a blocker is resolved unless a read above shows the upstream done or canceled, the context resolved, or the link gone.

Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."

10. CALL `set_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","blockerContext":"<saved:context>"} [A]

- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| x | the blocked activity: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity is blocked? (id or exact title)" |
| cause | what blocks it, in the user's words | STOP. Say: "What blocks <input:x>?" |
| who | who can remove the cause (a person, team or vendor) | STOP. Say: "Who can remove that cause?" |
| date | the day the block started (user), else today's UTC date, yyyy-mm-dd | — |
| still | "yes" or "no": the user's answer to "is the old cause still blocking?" | "unknown" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → switch to playbook connector-only.
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   IF <saved:xid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:x>'? <each item whose title contains it, as "<id>: <title>", or "none in <input:projectId>">. Send its id."
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; old = result.blockerContext.content when result.blockerContext.status == "active", else empty
   IF result.isDeleted == true or result.status is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is <result.status>, not an open activity. Nothing was recorded."
   IF <saved:old> contains <input:cause> → SAVE: text = <saved:old>; outcome = "already recorded, nothing changed"; go to Answer.
   IF <saved:old> is empty or <input:still> == "yes" → go to step 5.
   IF <input:still> == "unknown" → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> already has an active blocker: '<saved:old>'. Is it still blocking? yes = I keep both causes; no = I resolve it first. Nothing was changed."
   IF <saved:old> contains "portfolio link" → STOP. Say: "The old cause is a portfolio link. Close it first with playbook close-portfolio-link. Nothing was changed."
4. CALL `resolve_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","resolution":"No longer blocking (the user confirmed on <input:date>): <saved:old>"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "resolved" → STOP. Say: "The old blocker of <saved:xid> is still <result.blockerContext.status>. Nothing new was recorded."
5. SAVE: text = "<input:cause> — <input:who> — since <input:date>"
   IF <saved:old> is not empty and <input:still> == "yes" → SAVE: text = "<saved:old> | <saved:text>"; go to step 6.
   One context per activity: a new one REPLACES the active one, so the text keeps every cause that still blocks.
6. CALL `set_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","blockerContext":"<saved:text>"} [A] (no idempotencyKey: this tool has none; it also posts a comment)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not recorded: <error text>. Run this playbook again: it reads the context first."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "active" or result.blockerContext.content != <saved:text> → STOP. Say: "The blocker context of <saved:xid> does not show the new text."
   SAVE: outcome = "recorded"
7. CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: listed = "not checked (<error text>)"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: listed = the "Contexto do bloqueio" value of the item with id == <saved:xid>, else "not listed"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle>
Done: <blocker context "<saved:text>", <saved:outcome> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_issue → blockerContext active "<saved:text>"; list_blocked_project_issues → <saved:listed> | none>
Pending: <<input:cause> — <input:who> | the STOP text>
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | when the cause is gone, run playbook resolve-context>
```
blockerContext.status: active | resolved, from the VERIFY in step 6. A blocker context never changes the activity status; never set a status "blocked". Never claim a context that a VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-owner-decision

## Playbook: owner-decision
Use when: X waits for an owner decision

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.

Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."

   IF result.credential == "oauth" → switch to playbook connector-only.

   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   IF <saved:xid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:x>'? Send its id."
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; requirementId = result.requirementId; baselineId = result.baselineId; old = result.blockerContext.content when result.blockerContext.status == "active", else empty
   IF result.isDeleted == true or result.status is "done" or "canceled" → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is <result.status>, not an open activity. Nothing was recorded."
   IF <saved:old> contains "Waiting for an owner decision: <input:question>" → SAVE: text = <saved:old>; go to step 6.

   IF <saved:old> is not empty → SAVE: text = "<saved:old> | <saved:text>"; go to step 5.
   Keep every active cause in the text: a new context REPLACES the active one.

6. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]

   Decision needed: <input:question>
   Options: <input:options>

blockerContext.status: active | resolved. Never pick an option, never write that the owner decided, never change scope here (GOV-MAX v1). Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.


## § flow-resolve-context

## Playbook: resolve-context
Use when: the external cause is gone, or the owner decided

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| x | the blocked activity: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity is unblocked? (id or exact title)" |
| resolution | what removed the cause, in the user's words | STOP. Say: "What removed the blocker of <input:x>?" |
| decision | the owner's decision, quoted word for word from the owner in this conversation | "none" |
| gone | the cause that is gone, as the user named it | "all" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was written."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Resolving a blocker needs an LPM API key (profile full, planning or custom). Nothing was changed."
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   IF <saved:xid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:x>'? Send its id."
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; content = result.blockerContext.content
   IF result.blockerContext.status != "active" → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> has no active blocker context, so there is nothing to resolve. If a link blocks it, it ends when the upstream activity is done, or remove the link with playbook remove-link."
   SAVE: parts = <saved:content> split at " | "; ending = every part when <input:gone> == "all", else the parts that contain <input:gone>; rest = the parts not in <saved:ending>, joined with " | "
   IF <saved:ending> is empty → STOP. Say: "No active cause of <saved:xid> matches '<input:gone>'. Active: '<saved:content>'. Nothing was changed."
   IF a part of <saved:ending> contains "portfolio link" → switch to playbook close-portfolio-link.
   IF a part of <saved:ending> starts with "Waiting for an owner decision" and <input:decision> == "none" → STOP. Say: "This blocker needs the owner's decision (GOV-MAX v1). Quote the owner's decision, or open the thread with skill lpm-governance-decisions. Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: why = "<input:resolution>", plus " Owner decision (quoted): <input:decision>" when <input:decision> != "none"
4. CALL `resolve_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","resolution":"<saved:why>"} [A] (no idempotencyKey: this tool has none)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not resolved: <error text>. Run this playbook again: it reads the context first."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "resolved" → STOP. Say: "The blocker context of <saved:xid> is still <result.blockerContext.status>."
   IF <saved:rest> is empty → go to step 6.
5. CALL `set_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","blockerContext":"<saved:rest>"} [A]
   Make this call only for the causes that still block: the resolve above ended all of them.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "active" or result.blockerContext.content != <saved:rest> → STOP. Say: "The remaining causes of <saved:xid> were not recorded again: '<saved:rest>'."
6. CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: listed = "not checked (<error text>)"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: listed = the details of the item with id == <saved:xid>, else "not blocked any more"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle>
Done: <resolved "<saved:ending>" with "<saved:why>"; <still active: "<saved:rest>" | no cause left> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_issue → blockerContext <resolved | active "<saved:rest>">; list_blocked_project_issues → <saved:listed> | none>
Pending: <none | "<saved:rest>" | <saved:xid> still listed: <saved:listed>>
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | <saved:xid> can move | unblock what step 6 still lists>
```
blockerContext.status: active | resolved, from your last get_issue. Never resolve an owner decision without the owner's own quoted words. Never claim a blocker is gone unless a VERIFY or step 6 showed it.


## § flow-remove-link

## Playbook: remove-link
Use when: a link is wrong or dangling

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| workspaceId | the user, lpm-start, or step 3 | step 3 |
| x | an activity of the link: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity has the wrong link? (id or exact title)" |
| other | the other activity of the link: id, or words of its title the user used | "any" |
| linkId | the link id, when the user gave it | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was removed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Removing a link needs an LPM API key with profile full or custom. Nothing was removed."
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: titles = the id and title of every item; xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x>
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: workspaceId = <input:workspaceId>; go to step 4.
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.workspaceId, else <input:workspaceId>
4. CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: candidates = each item whose sourceIssueId or targetIssueId == <saved:xid>, kept only when (<input:other> == "any" or the other side's id equals <input:other> or its title in <saved:titles> contains <input:other>) and (<input:linkId> == "none" or its id == <input:linkId>); scope = "project"; line = "<id>: <sourceIssueId> "<title>" → <targetIssueId> "<title>" (<type>)", title from <saved:titles>, else "not found" (a dangling link)
   IF <saved:workspaceId> is empty → go to step 7.
5. CALL `list_workspace_issue_links` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","targetProjectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: candidates = <saved:candidates> plus each item with targetIssueId == <saved:xid>, same filters; scope = "workspace"; line = "<id>: <sourceProjectId>/<sourceIssueId> → <targetIssueId> "<title>" (<type>)"
6. CALL `list_workspace_issue_links` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","sourceProjectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: candidates = <saved:candidates> plus each item with sourceIssueId == <saved:xid>, same filters; scope = "workspace"; line = "<id>: <sourceIssueId> "<title>" → <targetProjectId>/<targetIssueId> (<type>)"
7. IF <saved:candidates> is empty → STOP. Say: "No link of <saved:xid> matches. Nothing was removed."
   IF <saved:candidates> has 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Which link? <each candidate's line, one per line>"
   SAVE: linkId, scope, line = those of the only candidate
   IF <saved:scope> == "workspace" → go to step 10.
8. ASK: "Remove link <saved:line> from <input:projectId>? It cannot be undone. Call: delete_issue_link projectId=<input:projectId>, linkId=<saved:linkId>. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was removed."
9. CALL `delete_issue_link` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","linkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error other than "Issue link not found" → STOP. Say: "Not removed: <error text>. Only a project manager with a full or custom API key can remove links."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_issue_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:linkId> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "removed"; go to step 12.
10. ASK: "Remove cross-project link <saved:line>? It cannot be undone. Call: delete_workspace_issue_link linkId=<saved:linkId>. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was removed."
11. CALL `delete_workspace_issue_link` {"linkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error other than "Workspace issue link not found" → STOP. Say: "Not removed: <error text>. Only a workspace owner or admin with a full or custom API key can remove it."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_issue_links` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:linkId> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "removed"
12. CALL `list_blocked_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: listed = "not checked (<error text>)"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: listed = the details of the item with id == <saved:xid>, else "not in the blocked list"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<saved:xid>
Done: <removed link <saved:line> | nothing removed>
Evidence: <list_issue_links or list_workspace_issue_links → <saved:linkId> absent; list_blocked_project_issues → <saved:xid>: <saved:listed> | none>
Pending: <none | <saved:xid> still blocked: <saved:listed> — the owner of that upstream activity>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | finish the upstream activity that step 12 still lists | none>
```
The blocked list shows same-project links only; a removed cross-project link changes the dependency summary, not this list. Never remove a link the user did not pick and confirm. Never claim an activity is unblocked unless step 12 no longer lists it.


## § flow-close-portfolio-link

## Playbook: close-portfolio-link
Use when: a link to another workspace is done or wrong

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.

| x | the activity in this project that the link touches: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity has the link? (id or exact title)" |
| linkId | the portfolio link id, when the user gave it | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."

   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Closing a link between workspaces needs an LPM API key (profile full, portfolio or custom). Nothing was changed."

   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x>

   SAVE: candidates = each item whose source.issueId or target.issueId == <saved:xid>, and whose id == <input:linkId> when <input:linkId> != "none"

   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: upStatus = "unreadable (<error text>)"; newStatus = "archived"; go to step 5.
   SAVE: upStatus = result.status; newStatus = "resolved" when <saved:upStatus> is "done" or "canceled", else "archived"
5. ASK: "Set portfolio link <saved:linkId> (<saved:upIssue> in <saved:upWs> <saved:type> <saved:xid>) to <saved:newStatus>? <saved:upIssue> is <saved:upStatus>. Call: update_portfolio_work_item_link linkId=<saved:linkId>, workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, status=<saved:newStatus>. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed."
6. CALL `update_portfolio_work_item_link` {"linkId":"<saved:linkId>","workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","status":"<saved:newStatus>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not changed: <error text>. Closing needs owner or admin in both workspaces."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_portfolio_work_item_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or the item with id == <saved:linkId> has a status != <saved:newStatus> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> does not show status <saved:newStatus>."
7. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; content = result.blockerContext.content
   IF result.blockerContext.status != "active" or <saved:content> does not contain <saved:linkId> → SAVE: contextDone = "no blocker context named the link"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: rest = the parts of <saved:content> split at " | " that do not contain <saved:linkId>, joined with " | "
8. CALL `resolve_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","resolution":"Portfolio link <saved:linkId> <saved:newStatus>"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "resolved" → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is <saved:newStatus>, but the blocker context of <saved:xid> is still <result.blockerContext.status>."
   SAVE: contextDone = "context resolved"
   IF <saved:rest> is empty → go to Answer.
9. CALL `set_project_issue_blocker_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","blockerContext":"<saved:rest>"} [A]
   Make this call only for the causes that still block: the resolve above ended all of them.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.blockerContext.status != "active" or result.blockerContext.content != <saved:rest> → STOP. Say: "The remaining causes of <saved:xid> were not recorded again: '<saved:rest>'."
   SAVE: contextDone = "context resolved; still active: <saved:rest>"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle>
Done: <portfolio link <saved:linkId> → <saved:newStatus>; <saved:contextDone> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <list_portfolio_work_item_links → <saved:linkId> <saved:newStatus>; get_issue → blockerContext <resolved | active> | none>
Pending: <none | "<saved:rest>">
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none | run playbook diagnose for <saved:xid>>
```
Link status: active | resolved | archived (resolved = the upstream work is done or canceled; archived = the link was wrong). Never claim a status or context change that a VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-connector-only

## Playbook: connector-only
Use when: record a blocker on a connector

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| x | the blocked activity: its id or its exact title | STOP. Say: "Which activity is blocked? (id or exact title)" |
| kind | "activity" (another activity must finish first), "decision" (an owner decision) or "external" | STOP. Say: "What blocks <input:x>: another activity, an owner decision, or something outside (vendor, person, access)?" |
| cause | what blocks it and who can remove it, in the user's words | STOP. Say: "What blocks <input:x>, and who can remove it?" |
| date | today's UTC date as yyyy-mm-dd | — |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was written."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential != "oauth" and <input:kind> == "activity" → switch to playbook add-link.
   IF result.credential != "oauth" and <input:kind> == "decision" → switch to playbook owner-decision.
   IF result.credential != "oauth" → switch to playbook blocker-context.
   IF result.scopes does not contain "portfolio:manage" → STOP. Say: "<the howToEnable text of the portfolio:manage item of result.unavailableToolGroups>. Remove and reinstall the connector and tick that box; disconnect and connect is not enough."
2. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: xid = id of the item whose id == <input:x>, else of the only item whose title == <input:x>, else <input:x> when result.nextCursor is not empty
   IF <saved:xid> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<input:x>'? Send its id."
3. CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:xid> is not an activity of <input:projectId>. Send its id."
   SAVE: xTitle = result.title; status = result.status; workspaceId = result.workspaceId
4. SAVE: note = this text, filled, in the user's language:
   ```text
   Blocker: <input:cause>
   Kind: <input:kind>
   Since: <input:date>
   Recorded as a comment: links and blocker contexts need an LPM API key.
   ```
5. CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF an item's content == <saved:note> → SAVE: commentId = that item's id; outcome = "already recorded"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: day = <input:date> without dashes; n = 1 + the number of items whose content starts with "Blocker:" and whose createdAt starts with <input:date>; key = "blocker-<saved:xid>-<saved:day>-<saved:n>"
6. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>","content":"<saved:note>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"; outcome = "recorded"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:xid>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing or has other text → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is not listed with the blocker note."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<saved:xid> <saved:xTitle>
Done: <comment <saved:commentId>, <saved:outcome> | nothing written>; status <saved:status>
Evidence: <list_comments → <saved:commentId> | none>
Pending: record it as a link or a blocker context — you, with an LPM API key or the web UI
Next: <the STOP text that ended the run | with an API key, run playbook <add-link | blocker-context | owner-decision> for <saved:xid>>
```
status: backlog | todo | in-progress | done | canceled, from step 3; a comment never makes an activity blocked and never changes its status. Never claim that a link or a blocker context exists.
